messages:
alex.t: Kicking off region-by-region handoff for v2.14 -> v2.15. US first tonight in the 00:00-02:00 UTC window. Plan: canary 5%, warm pool, then 25/50/100. pinging the oncall.

maria: Copy. I'll run capacity smoke (warm pool drain, queue length) ahead of canary. ETA 30m.

kenji: APAC needs special handling — we still have the instance refresh in ap-northeast scheduled at 03:30 UTC. Don't cut APAC into full traffic before that, keep it pinned to v2.14.

deploy-bot: deploy request received: env=prod regions=[us-east-1] version=v2.15 canary=0.05

sre-oncall: Noted. I'll watch p95 latency, 5xx rate, and queue depth. Thresholds: p95>400ms sustained 5m OR 5xx rate >2% => rollback trigger.

maria: capacity smoke results: us-east warm pool 120 GPUs available, avg token throughput 700k/min, queue depth nominal. No thermal events.

alex.t: Good. Start canary in us-east-one. Hold for 15m after steady state. If steady, proceed to 25%.

deploy-bot: canary started: region=us-east-1 id=deploy-1754321000-1

sre-oncall: canary metrics: p95 230ms, 5xx 0.1%, error budget ok. No throttles.

product-launch: FYI — release notes updated with breaking prompt behavior under the 'response-format' field. PS: we pinned EU to v2.14 until rollout complete.

kenji: EU pin is in place: eu-west-1 traffic routed to v2.14 via routing-policy: pin-eu-v2.14. Will monitor capacity for a manual lift.

alex.t: After US full roll, we'll do EU canary in a short maintenance window at 08:00 UTC; APAC will be final after the instance refresh. Keep rollback plan ready: `deploy-bot rollback --id deploy-1754321000-1`.

sre-oncall: Adding watchlist: eu-queue-depth, apac-thermal, db-connections. If any region shows >70% GPU saturation during ramp, pause next step and notify.

maria: I'll post the condensed rollback playbook in #eng-sre after verification. For now, tagging @kenji @sre-oncall for pre-APAC go/no-go.

kenji: Roger. Will confirm APAC warm pool health after refresh. If anything odd, we'll keep APAC pinned and backfill traffic from US/EU temporarily.

alex.t: TL;DR: US canary healthy -> escalate to 25% -> full. EU remains pinned until canary/validation at 08:00. APAC pinned until post-refresh. Rollback triggers: p95>400ms 5m OR 5xx>2% OR GPU saturation>85% sustained 3m. :thumbsup:
